title: V3LUM username overlay: corrections, exclusions and per-site tiers (P113 FC4)
notes: V3LUM-authored. Never copies or adapts WhatsMyName text: the 'definition' markers are V3LUM's own measurements from the captures named in 'measured' (P113 FC4, A6). A fix legal deems a WMN adaptation is CC BY-SA 4.0, attributed and never bundled: it then moves to a runtime download.
A5 names this overlay v3lum/data/username_overlay.json; batch file ownership places a module's bundled data under v3lum/data/<module>/, hence v3lum/data/username_check/overlay.json.

Per-site tier (A8/FC8): only 'trusted' or 'community' with a rationale is ever queried; unknown-tier sites never receive a username, at AMBER+STRICT only trusted sites. The provider registry fragment named in 'provider' must carry the same tier (checked by the tests).
Per-site terms (A1/FC16): the class of the registry source named in 'source' is authoritative at runtime; 'unknown' never runs in any profile and the default pack holds only 'open' sites.

Calibration (FC2/FC15): an official or organisation account as 'claimed' (never a private person's handle) and a random 20-character control. The records below were measured from the sandbox datacenter egress on 2026-11-26: the team re-measures them from its own egress (team_egress false until then), and doctor --sources re-tests them in rotation.
'exclusions' drop sites from both packs at pack build and at runtime; 'override_sherlock_exclusion' (not used today) needs a recorded decision with measured evidence.
